blocks.text: From January 2027 every team works to the same hybrid rhythm. This page sets out what changes, what stays the same and what we ask of you.
What changes in January
Two anchor days a week in the office, agreed per team and published in Places.
Core hours move to 10:00 to 15:30 in your local time.
Desk booking is required on office days, so we can plan space and catering.
What stays the same
You choose where you work on the other three days.
Flexible start and finish times, as long as your team knows how to reach you.

If your role, health or caring situation makes the anchor days hard, talk to your manager or your People partner. We agree exceptions case by case and keep them private.

Lock your screen whenever you step away from your desk.

items.caption: Keystone Dynamics is committed to transparency, ethical excellence, and strong corporate governance across all its divisions. By integrating ESG factors and adhering to its Code of Conduct, the company ensures accountability and long-term value for its stakeholders.
items.summary:
Guided by its Code of Conduct, the organization prioritizes ethical excellence, transparency, and accountability. This framework ensures operational integrity across all divisions, building stakeholder trust and supporting sustainable, long-term growth.

Furthermore, the company integrates environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors into its investment decisions and risk management. Detailed in annual reports, these practices reinforce corporate governance and fulfill fiduciary duties to its clients.

blocks.text: Our commitment to transparency, accountability, and ethical excellence forms the foundation of everything we do. Just as we measure our financial performance and operational milestones against the highest global standards, we hold ourselves to rigorous ethical benchmarks in our daily operations.

This Code of Conduct serves as our primary guide for maintaining integrity across all divisions, ensuring that our investment strategies, technological innovations, and industrial operations consistently deliver long-term value. By adhering to these principles, we foster trust with our stakeholders, clients, and the public, demonstrating that our commitment to sustainable growth is matched by our dedication to doing what is right.

In addition to financial metrics, our annual reports place a strong emphasis on corporate governance, risk management frameworks, and responsible investing practices. The publications detail how environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors are integrated into the investment decision-making process to mitigate risk and secure sustainable returns. By detailing executive compensation, board oversight, and strategic initiatives for the coming fiscal years, the reports reinforce our commitment to accountability and its fiduciary duty to the pension, endowment, and government funds it represents.

Leaders are held to the highest standards of integrity, accountability, and ethical stewardship. As guardians of our rich heritage and pioneers of our sustainable future, leaders must foster an inclusive, safe, and innovative environment where every voice is heard and respected.

Leadership means leading by example—demonstrating transparency in decision-making, championing compliance with global regulations, and actively mentoring the next generation of talent. By aligning strategic goals with core values, leaders ensure that we remain a trusted partner, a responsible global citizen, and a beacon of engineering and technological excellence.

blocks.text: Types of Time Off
Getting started
Requesting Time Off: Submit all time off requests through the global HR portal (hr.keystonedynamics.com) under the 'Time & Attendance' tab.
Manager Approval: Submit your requests as early as possible. Managers will review and respond to requests within 48 hours to ensure our operational and R&D teams have adequate coverage.
Frequently Asked Questions

At Keystone Dynamics, we know that taking time to recharge is essential to sustaining our engineering excellence and culture of innovation. This policy outlines our global guidelines for paid time off.
Category
Description
Guidelines
Annual Leave
Paid time off for vacation, rest, and personal time.
Varies globally (minimum 20 days per year).
Sick Leave
For personal illness, recovery, or medical appointments.
Subject to regional healthcare regulations.
Volunteer Days
Paid time to support local communities and Project Horizon initiatives.
2 days per calendar year.

data.header: How far in advance should I request time off?

blocks.text: For planned annual leave, please submit your request at least two weeks in advance. For sudden illnesses or emergencies, notify your manager as soon as reasonably possible.

data.header: Can I carry over unused Annual Leave to the next year?

blocks.text: You may carry over up to 5 days of unused Annual Leave into the first quarter of the following year. We strongly encourage you to use your time off to ensure you get the rest you deserve.

data.header: Who do I contact if I have questions about my regional balance?

blocks.text: Because regulations vary between our hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and regional manufacturing sites, please reach out to your local HR business partner or submit a ticket through the HR Connect portal.

A practical reference for supervisors who manage teams of frontline employees: call center, mobile care, customer operations. It tells you which AI tools your team is approved to use, what kinds of work they help with, and where the lines are.
Six chapters, none longer than a coffee break
Chapter 1: What your team is allowed to use, and how access works
Chapter 2: Drafting notes, summaries, and customer communications with AI
Chapter 3: Using AI to prep for one-on-ones and team huddles
Chapter 4: Quality, compliance, and the review steps that stay human
Chapter 5: What to do when AI gets something wrong
Chapter 6: Talking with your team about AI, especially the worried ones

items.caption: We launched its 2026 benefits plan featuring enhanced health coverage, sustainable retirement options, and an AI-driven enrollment portal. Employees are encouraged to review their personalized guides and submit selections by March 30, 2026.
items.summary:
Our 2026 benefits plan introduces a holistic approach to employee well-being, featuring specialized medical tiers with lower premiums and expanded mental health access. A new global telehealth initiative provides 24/7 medical consultations, while the retirement program is enhanced with increased 401(k) matching and ethical "Green Fund" investment options. To support financial planning, the company will also offer digital workshops and personalized coaching sessions for its global workforce.

Enrollment is now facilitated by an AI-driven portal that provides personalized recommendations and cost projections based on individual usage patterns. Family support is further strengthened through increased parental leave and childcare subsidies, alongside the "Flex" program, which allows employees to trade insurance riders for additional time off or development stipends. Staff must review their options and submit final selections through the portal by the March 30 2026, deadline.
items.title: 2026 Plan Highlights

blocks.text: Enhanced Health and Wellness Coverage

As Keystone Dynamics continues its evolution as a global leader in industrial and technological innovation, the 2026 benefits plan introduces a more holistic approach to employee well-being. This year, the company is expanding its medical insurance options to include specialized tiers that cater to the diverse needs of our 80,000-strong workforce. From frontline operational staff in our manufacturing hubs to corporate professionals in New York, London, and Singapore, the new plans offer lower premiums and expanded access to mental health services. Additionally, the introduction of a global telehealth initiative ensures that all employees have 24/7 access to medical consultations, regardless of their physical location or shift schedule.
Sustainable Financial Future and Retirement Planning

In alignment with our commitment to sustainable energy and long-term growth, the 2026 retirement benefits have been restructured to offer greater flexibility and ethical investment choices. Keystone Dynamics will now offer an enhanced 401(k) matching program that includes a suite of Green Fund options, allowing employees to invest their savings in renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure projects managed by Keystone Energy. To support financial literacy across all divisions, the company is also launching a series of digital workshops and one-on-one coaching sessions designed to help employees at every career stage navigate their long-term financial goals.
AI-Driven Enrollment and Personalized Support

Leveraging the expertise of Keystone Technologies, the 2026 enrollment process will be facilitated through a new, intuitive AI-driven portal. This platform is designed to simplify the selection process by analyzing individual usage patterns and life stages to provide personalized benefit recommendations. Whether an employee is looking for the best family coverage or maximizing their health savings account, the system offers real-time comparisons and cost projections. This technological upgrade ensures that the enrollment experience is efficient and accessible for both our factory floor teams and our research lab innovators.
Expanded Family Support and Flexible Work-Life Integration

Keystone Dynamics recognizes that our people are our greatest asset, and the 2026 plan reflects this through expanded family and lifestyle support. We are introducing increased parental leave durations and new childcare subsidies to support working parents across our global offices. Furthermore, the Keystone Flex initiative will allow employees to customize a portion of their benefits package, offering the ability to trade specific insurance riders for additional paid time off or professional development stipends. This flexibility underscores our culture of championing innovation and supporting the diverse lifestyles of our global team.
